jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

As Humana continues its transformation into an AI-first enterprise, we are looking for a hands-on, technically deep Principal Product Manager to define strategy and drive delivery across a portfolio of AI products. You will set the standard for how we build AI at Humana, and personally go deep, from understanding a business challenge, to prototyping an AI solution, to proving its value, to delivering it through Humana's enterprise AI governance process. You will lead through influence, making engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business leaders more effective.

What you will own

- Portfolio strategy and vision: Define the multi-year vision and strategy for a portfolio of AI products and capabilities. P rioritize across competing product areas and adapt the portfolio as the model landscape and the business change. Set the north-star and the long-term roadmap, and reason from first principles when the problem, opportunity, and strategy are not yet defined.

- Business discovery at scale: Partner with business-unit and enterprise leaders to map their operations end to end. Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into a slate of AI use cases, each with a clear business case, and sequence them into a portfolio.

- Hands-on prototyping: Build working prototypes and demos with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex) to prove feasibility and value before a full team is committed. Stay close enough to the technology to make credible technical calls.

- Requirements and scoping: Turn validated use cases into buildable requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics. Shape the end-to-end user experience with design, because adoption depends on usability.

- Delivery and execution: Drive the build from prototype to production across your portfolio . S equence the work, make scope and tradeoff calls as models and constraints shift, unblock teams, and keep momentum from first demo through launch and iteration.

- Evaluation and quality standards: Define how quality is measured. Build golden sets, error budgets, and eval frameworks; run offline and production evals; choose the right metrics (precision, recall, task success, hallucination rate); apply LLM-as-judge where it has been validated . Turn results into launch decisions and leadership readouts.

- Solution architecture: Partner with engineering on high-level architecture and feasibility across the portfolio, while owning the context engineering and skill-creation components of the AI harness and setting the reusable patterns others build on.

- Cross-organizational leadership: Lead engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business partners without direct authority. Influence VP-level organizations through written narratives, business cases, and executive forums. Author the playbooks, skills, and solution patterns for building AI at Humana.

- Governed delivery: Move solutions through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council), owning the product documentation, scorecards, and stage-gate reviews, and help shape the governance standards themselves as the portfolio grow s.

- Talent and standards: Raise the bar for the whole team. Mentor senior and lead product managers, contribute to hiring and promotion assessments, and set the craft standard for building with AI across the organization.

- Communication and influence: Communicate strategy, roadmap, requirements, ROI, and eval results clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences, and represent Humana's AI product work externally with partners, vendors, and the broader community.

- Staying current: Track advances in models, agents, evals, and emerging techniques (agent harness, loop, and graph / GraphRAG approaches), form a defensible point of view on where they are headed, and apply them across your portfolio.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications
- 10+ years of product or related experience, with AI/ML or GenAI products shipped to production. Candidates with fewer years but a strong engineering background and real fluency in AI will be considered.
- Portfolio-level impact: A track record of setting strategy and driving delivery across multiple products or a major domain, and of leading initiatives with org-wide, executive-level visibility.
- Hands-on building: You use AI tools regularly, prototype your own ideas, and can say specifically what you would change about a model's behavior and why. You know the trade-offs that matter: context windows, latency, cost, hallucination, and RAG versus fine-tuning.
- Evaluation expertise: You have built evals (golden sets, ground truth, and offline and live evals) and used precision- and recall-based metrics to make product decisions, and you have set eval standards that other teams adopt.
- Systems thinking: When you find a problem, you build the infrastructure that prevents the whole class of problem, and you make that infrastructure reusable across the organization.
- Communication across domains: You move fluently between business and technical concepts, with a track record of business cases, ROI models, and roadmaps that inform investment decisions at the executive level.
- AI knowledge: A deep working understanding of modern AI/ML and GenAI (LLMs, agents, RAG, prompt/harness engineering, and Evals) and how it applies to enterprise problems.
- You work from first principles, prioritize well, and make good calls quickly with incomplete information.

Preferred Qualifications
- 12+ years of product experience, or an equivalent depth of AI-native building, in a large enterprise environment.
- Experience in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry.
- A well-supported, publicly demonstrated point of view on where agentic AI, evals, and AI-native product development are headed.
- Hands-on experience with agent frameworks, GraphRAG / knowledge graphs, and reusable skills / plugins.
- Experience defining a new AI product category or standing up cross-organization AI standards and playbooks.
- Familiarity with responsible AI, bias mitigation, and compliance with sensitive data.
- A degree in computer science or engineering, or an equivalent combination of experience.

Additional Information

Responsible AI
Everything you ship will meet Humana's Responsible AI standards and clear our AI governance stage gates, with safety, fairness, privacy, and compliance built in from the start. As a Principal, you will help set those standards.

Work Style and Location:  This position follows a hybrid work schedule , requiring employees to work three days per week in the office and the remaining days remotely. Qualified candidates must currently reside within, or be willing to relocate to, a commutable distance from our office in New York, NY .

Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Technical Product Manager, Digital Pharmacy, will lead the development of next-generation digital pharmacy experiences and the reusable technical capabilities that power them.

This is a hands-on technical product role spanning strategy through execution. The Lead Technical Product Manager will shape product direction, define and prioritize capabilities, maintain a healthy and executable product backlog, and partner directly with Engineering and Architecture throughout discovery and delivery.

Digital Pharmacy will serve as an incubator for new pharmacy capabilities—rapidly testing and launching MVPs, learning from customer behavior and business outcomes, and evolving successful solutions into reusable components, services, APIs, and platform capabilities that can support multiple clients, channels, and pharmacy experiences.

We are looking for someone who can comfortably move between product strategy, customer experience, technical architecture, and detailed product execution—someone who sees technical depth and delivery rigor as fundamental parts of great product management.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Discovery
- Translate customer needs, business opportunities, and market insights into clear product priorities, capabilities, and roadmaps
- Partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and business teams to identify customer problems, define product hypotheses, and determine the right opportunities to pursue
- Define MVPs and incremental releases that allow us to deliver value, learn quickly, and continuously improve the product
- Establish clear product outcomes and use customer insights, analytics, and operational data to inform prioritization and iteration

Own & Manage the Product Backlog
- Translate product strategy, customer journeys, and experience designs into a clear, prioritized, development-ready backlog
- Define features and write and refine user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules with the level of detail required for Engineering to confidently begin development
- Lead ongoing backlog refinement and grooming with Engineering, ensuring upcoming work is well understood, appropriately decomposed, prioritized, and ready for delivery
- Maintain clear connections between product outcomes, capabilities, features, stories, dependencies, and releases
- Identify edge cases, expected system behaviors, data requirements, integrations, technical dependencies, and non-functional requirements where appropriate

Partner Deeply with Engineering & Architecture
- Develop strong working knowledge of the systems, APIs, services, integrations, data flows, and architectural patterns that enable Digital Pharmacy experiences
- Participate actively in technical discovery, solution design, refinement, and delivery discussions
- Partner with Engineering and Architecture to understand technical options and constraints, surface dependencies, challenge assumptions, and make informed product tradeoffs
- Ensure technical decisions remain connected to the customer problem and intended product outcome

Build for Reuse & Scale
- Think beyond the immediate feature or use case and identify opportunities to create reusable components, APIs, services, business rules, and platform capabilities
- Partner with Engineering and Architecture to determine where capabilities should be standardized for reuse across multiple products, channels, clients, and pharmacy experience
- Balance near-term product delivery with intentional investments in the technical foundations required for future scale

Incubate, Learn & Scale
- Use Digital Pharmacy as an incubator to rapidly test new experiences and capabilities
- Define the smallest meaningful MVP required to validate customer value, business value, or a product hypothesis
- Partner with Analytics to establish measurement and learning plans and use product performance, customer feedback, and operational insights to inform subsequent iterations

- Continuously evolve the backlog based on what we learn through discovery, development, and production usage

We are looking for a hands-on technical product leader with strong systems thinking and exceptional product execution discipline.

- 5-7+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or a similar role delivering complex digital products

- Demonstrated experience owning and actively managing complex product and engineering backlogs

- Strong experience writing detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and product requirements

- Strong technical fluency, including familiarity with APIs, services, integrations, data flows, system dependencies, and modern digital architectures

- Experience partnering directly with engineers and architects throughout the product development lifecycle

- Experience building platforms, shared services, or reusable capabilities that support multiple products, channels, clients, or experiences

- Strong product discovery, MVP definition, backlog decomposition, prioritization, and iterative delivery skills

- Ability to identify edge cases, dependencies, failure scenarios, and cross-system impacts

- Strong analytical skills and experience defining product outcomes and using data to drive iteration

- Ability to balance near-term delivery with longer-term scalability and platform strategy

jobs.title: Associate VP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Healthcare is rapidly changing, and our members are living longer, often with more chronic conditions. Consumers expect more personalized and holistic experiences from their health partners. Humana is committed to innovation to create new approaches and optimize existing assets to improve member experiences and health outcomes through better integrating Humana’s clinical capabilities, processes, and technology. This role will be instrumental in defining and executing on the vision of our transition to being a more health outcomes-oriented organization that also strengthens the financial performance of the business in partnership with leaders and teams across Humana.

The AVP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy is a senior leadership role at the center of this transformation. This leader will design, test, and scale new cross-functional approaches to clinical programs and products that measurably improve the experience, clinical outcomes, and total cost of care for our members. Working at the intersection of clinical strategy, product, and operations, the AVP will translate ambitious clinical priorities into pilots, launch them with rigor, and scale what works across the enterprise.
This is a challenging, highly visible role that demands the ability to navigate ambiguity, align many stakeholders around a shared vision, and deliver results in a complex, matrixed environment. It is also one of the most impactful roles on the team as it directly shapes how Humana improves health outcomes and lowers costs for millions of members.

Our team within Clinical Innovation & Trend employs a rigorous process to set specific clinical priorities for the enterprise, identify the greatest sources of value, and lead a multi-disciplinary process to identify discrete opportunities for enhanced clinical outcomes, cost control, quality, and member experience. The AVP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy will lead a substantial portion of this work as they own the end-to-end journey from clinical strategy through program and product design, implementation, and scaling.

Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities include:
- Drive enterprise-wide clinical strategy: play a leadership role on a team that develops and executes on enterprise-wide clinical strategies that drive improved health outcomes for our members.

- Lead clinical program and product design, implementation, and scaling by owning the full lifecycle from concept and pilot design through launch, and then maintaining strategic oversight as programs are scaled to ensure continuous improvement and sustained impact.

- Clinical program and intervention scope includes near to medium term value delivery of across digital health partnerships strategy and execution, Stars clinical strategy and interventions for key HEDIS measures (GSD / CBP and Care Coordination), and specialty strategy in key high-cost specialties (oncology, CV, MSK, kidney care, etc.).

- In addition, this leader is responsible for driving the evolution our long-term approach to integrated clinical products to deeply understand member needs and create a differentiated clinical experience and outcomes and cost impact.

- Lead both the team directly and drive deep collaboration with partner teams across the enterprise, uniting business leaders, clinicians, product managers, analytics, engineering, and design around common goals.

- Work across the organization in a multidisciplinary way to lead strategic partners across the enterprise, including business leaders, clinicians, and analytics experts, to develop strategies for complex clinical programs.

- Influence others across the organization to ensure enterprise-wide efforts are coordinated, focused on the highest-value opportunities, and take advantage of synergies that occur when multiple teams with different skillsets and scopes come together for common goals.

- Design, test, and scale new cross-functional approaches that improve the experience, clinical outcomes, and cost of care for members, building repeatable capabilities and operating models that outlast any single initiative.

- Provide strategic input, updates, and presentations to enterprise-wide forums.

- Influence senior decision-makers at Humana on opportunities to improve health, lower costs, and improve experience for members, providers, and associates.

- Exercise independent judgment and decision making on complex issues and bring others along with them.

Required Qualifications
- MD or DO degree
- 10+ years of strategy and operations development and implementation experience for healthcare-related organizations.
- Clinical operations experience and expertise, including a deep understanding of how care is delivered across payers and providers, and especially the intersection between the two.
- Product experience managing multidisciplinary teams, including analytics, engineering, design, and clinical roles, to build and scale programs or products.
- Strong business and/or consulting experience.
- Solid business and financial acumen.
- Experience with analytics and use of data.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to execute on complex projects.
- Process improvement experience.
- Ability to influence, establish, and drive improved business outcomes.
